interpretation: A second run with S/PDIF held fixed reproduces the user-observed dropout and error bit 0x0400. Source tracing maps this bit to audio_pcm_output_adapter: after playback starts, an empty FIFO causes zero output and sets starvation_waiting; subsequent non-end data latches underrun. This identifies an internal audio-supply interruption, not a receiver clipping or loudness detector. The snapshot at 1.827817683 seconds records the latched flag after data resumes, not the exact start or duration of starvation. Upstream cause and exact audible-time correlation remain unisolated.
limitations: The snapshot freezes on the early error. Its 408434 video bytes, 25 reference plus 20 B pictures, 44 bank-derived display pictures and 43 swaps are not final playback totals. Generic fatal_or_no_progress is triggered by the audio flag; there are no other set error bits.
The flag is sticky and does not count underruns; it latches when data resumes after starvation, not at the initial empty event. Neither dropout duration nor receiver lock behavior is measured.
Full helper EOF and exit zero establish completed transport, not uninterrupted audio output or full video acceptance.

Legacy deadline 42 and outlier 21 counts are not authored-film-cadence-aware. Six timestamp-advance conflicts are due candidates outside cadence slots rather than proven early publications; no delay conflicts are recorded. These diagnostics are not being waived.
PCM 16383 and peak 127 are saturated diagnostic fields, not full carrier sample totals or FIFO capacity.
Actual S/PDIF output and loudness have not been instrumented. Receiver resynchronization could be a consequence of disrupted delivery, but that behavior is not established here.

loudness_hypothesis: The user suspects the brassy loud opening. The passthrough branch bypasses audio decoding and emits each AC-3 frame in a fixed 1536-sample stereo carrier period at 48 kHz, regardless of musical amplitude. Loudness alone is therefore not supported as the cause of this FIFO underrun. The passage may coincide with delivery pressure; no amplitude measurement or receiver-lock trace was collected.
